annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT), Oman
annotation.summary_en: Ministry web page describing Oman's National Program for Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Digital Technologies, approved by Cabinet in September 2024. It covers AI adoption in economic sectors, localisation of AI technologies and human-centric governance, with no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Program approved by Cabinet on 19 September 2024, aligned with Oman Vision 2040
Aims to raise the digital economy's contribution from 2% (2021) to 10% by 2040
Promotes AI adoption in education, healthcare, security and social services
Localises AI industries via public-private partnerships and incentives for AIaaS
Human-centric governance: ethical, fair, safe AI and review of laws on privacy and data
